roughness.source: Workings/polished.stone.json: surface.gloss (75 GU or more at 60 degrees: high gloss); unverified surface.specularLobeWidth
roughness.note: A face that holds sharp images; no measured BRDF of a polished calcite stone was read, so a first narrow lobe.

roughnessAcross.source: Workings/polished.stone.json: surface.physics (polishing removes the roughness; a polished face has no grain)
roughnessAcross.derivation: a face with no grain: equal to the roughness along

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.source: Workings/polished.stone.json: surface.openPorosity (polishing and filling close the near-surface pores)
textureDepth.note: A polished face holds almost no film; a first value.

relief.note: A polished face is flat to the eye; a first value.
